next.reason: 1985 (rule added by Amendment 1, X3.23a-1989, Errata C159): 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function' (§1985:XIV.3.6.3 SR6), on the FROM operand of the Communication module's SEND cd-name-1 ('Cd-name-1 must reference an output CD or input-output CD', §1985:XIV.3.6.3 SR1). 2023 has no communication facility and no cd-name: its SEND 'sends a message to a message server run unit' (§2023:14.9.38.1), a different statement, whose one rule on identifier-1 lists clauses its description 'shall not contain' (§2023:14.9.38.3 SR3). No 2023 rule restricts a function-identifier in a SEND, so the requirement is dropped with the feature, as the statement's other syntax rules were.
